notes: Narratives are the cell comments of the Dash area blocks: one comment per area and month, holding one or more event passages separated by blank lines.

The event type comes from the block, the area from the block's area label (column B) and the month from the block's dated header row. Dates, numbers and classifications come only from the passage text.
Comments on other sheets are listed as excluded: Incident Data repeats Dash narratives for some classification cells and holds contributing-factor lists that are not events.
